title: ISB Security Platform: Active Development
intro: Now: refine and validate operational, reporting, workforce, planning, object-management and selected offline workflows. Next: complete current integration and recovery work, and the required environment and authority validation. Later: expand connected operational capabilities, external integrations and advanced AI research.
disclaimer: The platform has not been announced as commercially available or production-validated. No public release date has been established. Priorities may change. Stage placement is not a delivery commitment.
foundationsNote: Technical foundations already include role-based access, company-scoped data, scheduling and assignment authority, attendance and worked time, audit and events, bounded billing and payroll data, an integration outbox, and selected offline reporting and patrol workflows. Those foundations are not commercial availability.
